name: Chain Lightning
description: You target a creature within moderate (20 unit) range and strike them with a devastating bolt of lightning, dealing 40 electric damage if your spell check beats the target's defense. The bolt then arcs to the nearest creature within a very short (5 unit) distance of the last target hit, dealing 5 less damage with each arc. The bolt arcs a number of times equal to the number of successes on your spell check. A creature can only be hit once by this spell.
charge: The initial damage increases to 50 and the arc range increases to short (10 units).
